_comment: Hand-curated inputs for tools/art-manifest/generate.py (build-time only). Width bar 3000px per owner decision 2026-10-24 (A+B corrections). Icons excluded in P1 (separate legal basis, deferred to P3).
_life_based_overrides_comment: The ONLY admission route for a life-based-only file (source = PD-old-70 / PD-old-auto / PD-Russia / PD-Russia-expired with no self-contained PD-RusEmpire / PD-Russia-1996 / PD-old-100 template). Map pageid(string) -> {"eligible": true, "death_year": <int>, "notes": "..."} after a human verifies the death facts. EMPTY in P1: every life-based-only file is rejected unconditionally. P3 populates the curated Soviet/life-based garnish here. The gate NEVER parses the free-text Artist field to decide eligibility.
_artists_comment: Reference-only in P1 (recorded legal research; NOT consumed by the P1 gate decision). P3 wires these per-artist death facts into per-pageid life_based_overrides entries.

Ivan Shishkin.notes: 19th-c, died well before 1952 wartime window; URAA-clean
